name: challenging
finalText:
The Diceret cell in the Iuvaret4 row reads **Phaedrum4**. After I clicked that row's "edit" link, the URL was **https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/challenging_dom#edit**.

**How I identified the row:**
- I read the table text and the screenshot. The row whose first cell (the "Lorem" column) says **Iuvaret4** is the fifth data row. It sits between the Iuvaret3 and Iuvaret5 rows.
- In that row, the cell under the **Diceret** header (the sixth column) says **Phaedrum4**. The other cells in the row are Apeirian4, Adipisci4, Definiebas4 and Consequuntur4.
- I clicked the "edit" link in the Action column of that same row, at about y=479 in the screenshot. That is the same height as the Iuvaret4 and Phaedrum4 cells. After the click, that link showed as focused or visited, and the URL gained the `#edit` fragment.

The click only added `#edit` to the URL and the page didn't change. This is normal for this demo.
